ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Mars

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1810231534000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.
